slides.title: 5 mistakes that [cut] your claim
slides.promise: Most owners find out after the fire. Swipe before yours.

slides.label: Late renewal = no cover
slides.body: A fire 1 day after expiry isn't covered by that policy. Most claim cuts start with a small, boring mistake.

slides.title: Insuring market price
slides.body: Your sum insured should follow rebuild cost, not what you paid. Get it wrong and the claim can be cut.

slides.title: No stock register
slides.body: In 2026, India's Supreme Court upheld a full claim rejection where the stock didn't match the books.

slides.title: Self-heating stock
slides.yes: Fire from an outside cause, like a short circuit
slides.no: Your own cotton, coal or oil cake heating up and burning, unless you add the endorsement

slides.title: The empty factory
slides.fact: Many policies exclude buildings empty for over 30 days. Tell your insurer in writing.

slides.title: Wrong declaration
slides.body: Shop on the form, godown in reality? A false declaration can sink the claim. Report every change.

slides.title: Send this to 1 business owner
slides.sub: 1 fire cause, 1 claim lesson, every post.
